merger_description:
Armira Opportunities III GmbH & Co. geschlossene Investment KG (**Armira Opportunities III**, and together with all affiliated companies and funds **Armira**), and TA Riverside Aggregator LP (**TA Riverside Aggregator**), a special purpose vehicle created by certain funds controlled by TA Associates Cayman, LLC (the **TA Funds**, and together with all affiliated companies and funds, including TA Riverside Aggregator, **TA Associates**) intend to indirectly acquire, through Riverside BidCo Limited (**Riverside BidCo**), joint control over the whole of Intersurgical Aktiengesellschaft AG (**Intersurgical**, and together with all its controlled entities, the **Intersurgical Group**) by way of purchase of shares (the **Acquisition**).

Armira is an alternative investment fund manager headquartered in Munich, Germany, which specialises in providing capital for long-term partnerships and focusing on family-owned businesses and technology companies, primarily in Europe.  

  

TA Associates is private equity firm headquartered in Boston, United States that invests, through the TA Funds, in companies across five target industries: technology, financial services, healthcare, consumer, and business services.

Intersurgical is a Liechtenstein-based company which, through its operating subsidiaries (including Intersurgical Limited) controls the business of the Intersurgical Group.

The Intersurgical Group is a global designer, manufacturer and supplier of medical devices for respiratory support, used in anaesthesia, intensive care, emergency care and oxygen therapy in hospitals and in the home. Its product range includes medical devices used in:

* Airway management
* Anaesthesia
* Emergency and resuscitation care
* Critical care
* Oxygen and aerosol therapy, nebuliser therapy, and respiratory physiotherapy.

determination_table_content.details:
Armira Opportunities III GmbH & Co. geschlossene Investment KG
(Armira Opportunities III, and together with all affiliated companies
and funds, Armira) and TA Riverside Aggregator LP (TA Riverside
Aggregator), a special purpose vehicle created by certain funds
controlled by TA Associates Cayman, LLC (the TA Funds, and
together with all affiliated companies and funds, including TA
Riverside Aggregator, TA Associates), propose to indirectly acquire,
via Riverside Bidco Limited, share capital in and exercise joint control
over Intersurgical Aktiengesellschaft AG (Intersurgical, and together
with its controlled entities, Intersurgical Group), as described in the
transaction documents provided as part of the application (the
Acquisition).
TA Riverside Aggregator and Armira Opportunities III applied for a
notification waiver in respect of the Acquisition.

The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission has
determined under section 51ABV(1)(a) of the Competition and
Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.

The acquirer, Riverside Bidco Limited, is currently an indirect wholly
owned subsidiary of Armira Opportunities III.
Armira is a Munich-based alternative investment fund manager,
which specialises in providing capital for long-term partnerships and
focusing on family-owned businesses and technology companies,
primarily in Europe.
TA Associates is a private equity firm headquartered in Boston,
United States, that invests, through the TA Funds, in companies
across five target industries: technology, financial services,
healthcare, consumer, and business services.
The target, Intersurgical, is a holding company registered in
Liechtenstein which, through its operating subsidiaries (including
Intersurgical Limited) controls the business of the Intersurgical
Group.
The Intersurgical Group is a global designer, manufacturer and
supplier of medical devices for respiratory support, used in
anaesthesia, intensive care, emergency care and oxygen therapy in
hospitals and in the home. Its offering includes products for airway
management, anaesthesia, emergency and resuscitation care,
critical care, oxygen and aerosol therapy, nebuliser therapy, and
respiratory physiotherapy.
Intersurgical Limited has entered into a separate equity purchase
agreement with Teleflex Inc. to acquire the acute care and
interventional urology business of Teleflex Inc. (the Teleflex
Business).

In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver application and
had regard to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition
and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information provided in the application, the ACCC
considers that the Acquisition is unlikely to give rise to any material
lessening of competition. There is no horizontal overlap or vertical
relationship between Armira (or its connected entities) and
Intersurgical (including the Teleflex Business), or between TA
Associates (or its connected entities) and Intersurgical (including the
Teleflex Business), in the supply of medical devices for respiratory
support in Australia.
In these circumstances, the ACCC does not consider it necessary to
reach a concluded view on the likelihood of the notification
thresholds being met.
Given that material competition concerns are unlikely to arise, the
ACCC has determined that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.
The ACCC considers that the determination is consistent with the
object of the Act and the interests of consumers in promoting
competition.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notification waiver applications and to assessing competition
effects more generally, see the ACCC’s guidance on notification
waivers and merger assessment guidelines.
